newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt extends deadline for battery firm auction.
newsitem.headline: Egypt extends deadline for battery firm auction.

text.p: Egypt's official Holding Company for Chemical Industries said on Monday it was extending the deadline for bids to buy a 38 percent stake in batteries firm Chloride Egypt until February 3, 1997.
In a published announcement, the firm said it was moving the closing date for bids from January 16 at the request of some investors.
Last month, the state offered for auction the 38 percent or 34,200 shares to one or more strategic investor. Egypt's Commercial International Bank (CIB) is handling the sale.
Chloride Egypt has a capital of nine million pounds ($2.6 million). It manufactures automotive and industrial batteries.

An Arab investor owns 52 percent of the firm and the American University's Investment Fund owns the remaining 10 percent, the agents for the sale said. The Arab investor had bought the stake from British firm Chloride Plc, they added.
